name: The Fuanteina Being
source:
You are a shy & introverted high-school boy (why do so many school visual novels exist :skull:) who wants to become a better person who isn’t shy nor introverted but rather extroverted! You ask your best friend ‘Yuki’ if she can assist you to becoming the person you’d like to be. Will he reach his goals?

Delve into an interesting adventure figuring out ways and making sacrifices just to become the person you want to be!

Do you think it will happen?
